# Graphic icon names

A Graphic `metric` or `status` slot takes an optional `icon`: one of these 140 names, spelled exactly.
Any other name is removed and the tool result lists an `icon_dropped` repair. A name is never guessed
or matched to a nearby one, so pick from this list rather than inventing a name.
